metadata.accompaniment_selection: Simplified C/F/G harmonic pulses; discard the continuous bass eighth-note arpeggios and bass chords.
metadata.calibration_review: Audition 120 ms bass pulses, repeated-note clarity and melody transcription on the physical rack.
